defect: published v0.7.12: a cursor file was a bare number with no channel and no journal; handing it to the other channel or another journal exited 0 and delivered the wrong thing — silent starvation (0 rows, undelivered backlog), duplicate replay, or a permanent gap
rule: a cursor reeflog wrote is honoured only by the same channel of the same journal; a crossing is refused with nothing delivered and the file untouched; a bare hand-written number stays legal
